requests.summary: Count-only report plan review uses concise structured output, retaining independent verification. Local synthetic replay latency improved; production has not been deployed or retimed.

investigation.cause: Extended hidden reasoning in the independent report-plan verifier dominated latency. The original path used three model calls; the change retains all three and the existing validation/clarification gates.
investigation.scope: Only report catalogs whose available metrics are all non-derived counts (including audience growth) receive think=false with a 700-token output budget. Any derived or percentage metric retains the original extended reasoning path. Non-report and clarification verification are unchanged.
investigation.semantic_guard: An initial broader fast-review variant chose the wrong ratio metrics in a fresh probe. It was narrowed before completion; the final ratio probe selected clicks_per_open correctly, and an unavailable audience revenue probe requested clarification without substituting a metric.
investigation.data: Synthetic in-memory report fixtures; original private request used only as an untracked replay input. No production business records imported. Actual calculations and three-stage model pipeline executed using the local development model in a disposable container.
